name: Water Breathing
description: A swordsmanship style used by Tanjiro Kamado and Giyu Tomioka. The official Demon Slayer character materials identify both characters with this style.

name: Hinokami Kagura
description: A traditional dance technique used by Tanjiro Kamado in combat; official anime material identifies Tanjiro as a user.
origin: Kamado family tradition; further history is not expanded in this record.

name: Thunder Breathing
description: A swordsmanship style used by Zenitsu Agatsuma. Official Demon Slayer character materials identify him as its wielder.

name: Beast Breathing
description: A swordsmanship style used by Inosuke Hashibira. Official Demon Slayer character materials identify him as its user.
origin: Inosuke’s self-developed combat style, as represented in the anime character materials.

name: Ten Shadows Technique
description: A hereditary Zenin-family jujutsu technique used by Megumi Fushiguro.

name: Construction Technique
description: Mai Zenin’s cursed technique constructs matter from cursed energy.

name: Cursed Speech
description: A cursed technique used by Toge Inumaki. Its commands are delivered through speech.
